svg.text: Runs once per chat at session end: after 10 idle minutes, a disconnect, sign-out, shutdown, or at the next start for a chat a crash left unfinished.
If not local: nothing is sent, the chat stays queued.
* Drawn more than once to avoid crossing lines (same store). Dashed: a candidate the evidence gate refuses goes straight to 3.8, which records the refusal.
